Ui.Script:
local ZOOM_STEP = 1.25 -- The deepest zoom, in multiples of the widest zone's stock size. local ZOOM_DEPTH = 4 local MAX_PLATES = 8 local TILE = 256 local TILES_WIDE = 4
local zoom = 1 local zoomMax = 1 local pan = nil local canvas = nil local onCanvas = false local opening = false -- The zone the dropdown names: the last chosen, or the one the map opened on. local chosen = nil local plates = {}
local detail = WorldMapDetailFrame local baseWidth = detail:GetWidth() local baseHeight = detail:GetHeight() local view = CreateFrame("ScrollFrame", "WorldMapZoomFrame", WorldMapFrame) local level = detail:GetFrameLevel() local buttonLevel = level + MAX_PLATES + 2
do local points = {} for i = 1, detail:GetNumPoints() do points[i] = { detail:GetPoint(i) } end view:SetScale(detail:GetScale()) view:SetWidth(baseWidth) view:SetHeight(baseHeight) for i = 1, table.getn(points) do local p = points[i] view:SetPoint(p[1], p[2], p[3], p[4], p[5]) end if level > 0 then view:SetFrameLevel(level - 1) end detail:ClearAllPoints() detail:SetParent(view) detail:SetScale(1) view:SetScrollChild(detail) detail:SetFrameLevel(level) view:EnableMouseWheel(true) view:Show() end
-- A script level change moves no children, so each descendant moves by hand. local function BenillaCanvas_Lift(frame, delta) local children = { frame:GetChildren() } for i = 1, table.getn(children) do children[i]:SetFrameLevel(children[i]:GetFrameLevel() + delta) BenillaCanvas_Lift(children[i], delta) end end
-- The area label stays at the top of the view instead of scrolling with the map. WorldMapFrameAreaFrame:SetParent(WorldMapFrame) WorldMapFrameAreaFrame:ClearAllPoints() WorldMapFrameAreaFrame:SetPoint("TOP", view, "TOP", 0, -10)
do local oldLevel = WorldMapButton:GetFrameLevel() WorldMapButton:SetParent(detail) WorldMapButton:ClearAllPoints() WorldMapButton:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", detail, "TOPLEFT", 0, 0) WorldMapButton:SetFrameLevel(buttonLevel) BenillaCanvas_Lift(WorldMapButton, buttonLevel - oldLevel) WorldMapFrameAreaFrame:SetFrameLevel(buttonLevel + 2) end
local function BenillaCanvas_ZoomOf(entry) return 1 / entry.width end
local function BenillaCanvas_SetSize() detail:SetWidth(baseWidth * zoom) detail:SetHeight(baseHeight * zoom) WorldMapButton:SetWidth(baseWidth * zoom) WorldMapButton:SetHeight(baseHeight * zoom) end
local function BenillaCanvas_SetOffsets(x, y) local overX = math.max(0, detail:GetWidth() - view:GetWidth()) local overY = math.max(0, detail:GetHeight() - view:GetHeight()) view:SetHorizontalScroll(math.min(0, math.max(-overX, x))) view:SetVerticalScroll(math.max(0, math.min(overY, y))) end
local function BenillaCanvas_Plate(i) local plate = plates[i] if plate then return plate end plate = CreateFrame("Frame", "BenillaCanvasPlate" .. i, detail) plate:SetWidth(baseWidth) plate:SetHeight(baseHeight) plate:SetFrameLevel(level + i) plate.tiles = {} for n = 1, NUM_WORLDMAP_DETAIL_TILES do local tile = plate:CreateTexture(nil, "BACKGROUND") tile:SetWidth(TILE) tile:SetHeight(TILE) tile:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", plate, "TOPLEFT", TILE * math.mod(n - 1, TILES_WIDE), -TILE * math.floor((n - 1) / TILES_WIDE)) plate.tiles[n] = tile end plate.pieces = {} plates[i] = plate return plate end
-- The entry's overlays in 256 px pieces, as the stock WorldMapFrame_Update cuts them. local function BenillaCanvas_Pieces(plate, overlays) local count = 0 for i = 1, table.getn(overlays) do local o = overlays[i] local wide = math.ceil(o.width / TILE) local tall = math.ceil(o.height / TILE) for j = 1, tall do local pixelHeight, fileHeight = TILE, TILE if j == tall then pixelHeight = math.mod(o.height, TILE) if pixelHeight == 0 then pixelHeight = TILE end fileHeight = 16 while fileHeight < pixelHeight do fileHeight = fileHeight * 2 end end for k = 1, wide do local pixelWidth, fileWidth = TILE, TILE if k == wide then pixelWidth = math.mod(o.width, TILE) if pixelWidth == 0 then pixelWidth = TILE end fileWidth = 16 while fileWidth < pixelWidth do fileWidth = fileWidth * 2 end end count = count + 1 local piece = plate.pieces[count] if not piece then piece = plate:CreateTexture(nil, "ARTWORK") plate.pieces[count] = piece end piece:SetWidth(pixelWidth) piece:SetHeight(pixelHeight) piece:SetTexCoord(0, pixelWidth / fileWidth, 0, pixelHeight / fileHeight) piece:ClearAllPoints() piece:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", plate, "TOPLEFT", o.offsetX + TILE * (k - 1), -(o.offsetY + TILE * (j - 1))) piece:SetTexture(o.texture .. ((j - 1) * wide + k)) piece:Show() end end end for i = count + 1, table.getn(plate.pieces) do plate.pieces[i]:Hide() end end
-- Each plate is 1002x668 in its own units at scale `width * zoom`, so its anchor offset, -- in those units, does not change with the zoom. local function BenillaCanvas_SeatPlates() local count = 0 if onCanvas then count = math.min(table.getn(canvas), MAX_PLATES) end for i = 1, count do local entry = canvas[i] local plate = BenillaCanvas_Plate(i) plate:SetScale(entry.width * zoom) plate:ClearAllPoints() plate:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", detail, "TOPLEFT", entry.left * baseWidth / entry.width, -entry.top * baseHeight / entry.width) for n = 1, NUM_WORLDMAP_DETAIL_TILES do plate.tiles[n]:SetTexture("Interface\\WorldMap\\" .. entry.file .. "\\" .. entry.file .. n) end BenillaCanvas_Pieces(plate, entry.overlays) plate:Show() end for i = count + 1, table.getn(plates) do plates[i]:Hide() end end
local function BenillaCanvas_ShowStock(shown) for i = 1, NUM_WORLDMAP_DETAIL_TILES do local tile = getglobal("WorldMapDetailTile" .. i) if shown then tile:Show() else tile:Hide() end end if shown then WorldMapContinentDropDown:Show() WorldMapZoomOutButton:Show() else WorldMapContinentDropDown:Hide() WorldMapZoomOutButton:Hide() for i = 1, NUM_WORLDMAP_OVERLAYS do getglobal("WorldMapOverlay" .. i):Hide() end end end
-- The player arrow is a child of the map frame, under the plates; on the canvas it rides -- in WorldMapButton, clipped and above them. local function BenillaCanvas_LiftArrow() local children = { WorldMapFrame:GetChildren() } for i = 1, table.getn(children) do if children[i]:GetObjectType() == "Model" then children[i]:SetParent(WorldMapButton) children[i]:SetFrameLevel(buttonLevel + 1) end end end
local function BenillaCanvas_SetZoom(newZoom) zoom = math.max(1, math.min(zoomMax, newZoom)) if zoom < 1.0001 then zoom = 1 end BenillaCanvas_SetSize() if zoom > 1 then WorldMapButton:RegisterForDrag("LeftButton") else pan = nil WorldMapButton:RegisterForDrag() end end
-- Sets the zoom and puts canvas UV (u, v) at the view's centre. local function BenillaCanvas_ZoomTo(newZoom, u, v) BenillaCanvas_SetZoom(newZoom) BenillaCanvas_SetOffsets(view:GetWidth() / 2 - u * detail:GetWidth(), v * detail:GetHeight() - view:GetHeight() / 2) WorldMapFrame_Update() end
-- The last canvas entry whose rect holds (u, v). local function BenillaCanvas_EntryAt(u, v) local found = nil for i = 1, table.getn(canvas) do local e = canvas[i] if u >= e.left and u <= e.left + e.width and v >= e.top and v <= e.top + e.height then found = e end end return found end
local function BenillaCanvas_Sorted() local list = {} for i = 1, table.getn(canvas) do table.insert(list, canvas[i]) end table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.name < b.name end) return list end
local function BenillaCanvas_Open() opening = false pan = nil local u, v = GetPlayerMapPosition("player") local entry = nil if u ~= 0 or v ~= 0 then entry = BenillaCanvas_EntryAt(u, v) end if entry then chosen = entry.name BenillaCanvas_ZoomTo(BenillaCanvas_ZoomOf(entry), u, v) else BenillaCanvas_ZoomTo(1, 0.5, 0.5) end WorldMap_UpdateZoneDropDownText() end
-- Follows `GetMapCanvas()` on and off the canvas. local function BenillaCanvas_Refresh() canvas = GetMapCanvas() if canvas and not onCanvas then onCanvas = true -- The widest zone has the smallest stock-size zoom. local widest = nil for i = 1, table.getn(canvas) do local z = BenillaCanvas_ZoomOf(canvas[i]) if not widest or z < widest then widest = z end end zoomMax = math.max(1, ZOOM_DEPTH * (widest or 1)) BenillaCanvas_LiftArrow() BenillaCanvas_ShowStock(false) opening = true elseif not canvas and onCanvas then onCanvas = false chosen = nil BenillaCanvas_SetZoom(1) zoomMax = 1 view:SetHorizontalScroll(0) view:SetVerticalScroll(0) BenillaCanvas_ShowStock(true) BenillaCanvas_SeatPlates() end end
function BenillaMapCanvas_GetZoom() return zoom end
function BenillaMapCanvas_OnMouseWheel(delta) if not onCanvas then return end if delta < 0 and zoom <= 1 then return end local cx, cy = GetCursorPosition() local scale = view:GetEffectiveScale() -- The cursor in view units from the view's top-left, y down, and the map point under it. local px, py = cx / scale - view:GetLeft(), view:GetTop() - cy / scale local u = (px - view:GetHorizontalScroll()) / detail:GetWidth() local v = (py + view:GetVerticalScroll()) / detail:GetHeight() if delta < 0 then BenillaCanvas_SetZoom(zoom / ZOOM_STEP) else BenillaCanvas_SetZoom(zoom * ZOOM_STEP) end BenillaCanvas_SetOffsets(px - u * detail:GetWidth(), v * detail:GetHeight() - py) WorldMapFrame_Update() end
function BenillaMapCanvas_DragStart() if zoom <= 1 then return end local cx, cy = GetCursorPosition() pan = { cx = cx, cy = cy, x = view:GetHorizontalScroll(), y = view:GetVerticalScroll(), } end
function BenillaMapCanvas_DragStop() pan = nil end
function BenillaMapCanvas_Pan() if not pan then return end local cx, cy = GetCursorPosition() local scale = view:GetEffectiveScale() BenillaCanvas_SetOffsets(pan.x + (cx - pan.cx) / scale, pan.y + (cy - pan.cy) / scale) end
view:SetScript("OnMouseWheel", function() BenillaMapCanvas_OnMouseWheel(arg1) end) view:SetScript("OnShow", function() opening = true BenillaCanvas_Refresh() if onCanvas then BenillaCanvas_Open() end end) view:SetScript("OnUpdate", BenillaMapCanvas_Pan) WorldMapButton:SetScript("OnDragStart", BenillaMapCanvas_DragStart) WorldMapButton:SetScript("OnDragStop", BenillaMapCanvas_DragStop)
local BenillaCanvas_OldUpdate = WorldMapFrame_Update function WorldMapFrame_Update() BenillaCanvas_OldUpdate() BenillaCanvas_Refresh() if onCanvas then BenillaCanvas_ShowStock(false) end BenillaCanvas_SeatPlates() if opening and onCanvas and view:IsVisible() then BenillaCanvas_Open() end end
local BenillaCanvas_OldZoneInit = WorldMapZoneDropDown_Initialize function WorldMapZoneDropDown_Initialize() if not onCanvas then BenillaCanvas_OldZoneInit() return end local list = BenillaCanvas_Sorted() for i = 1, table.getn(list) do local info = {} info.text = list[i].name info.func = WorldMapZoneButton_OnClick UIDropDownMenu_AddButton(info) end end
local BenillaCanvas_OldZoneClick = WorldMapZoneButton_OnClick function WorldMapZoneButton_OnClick() if not onCanvas then BenillaCanvas_OldZoneClick() return end local entry = BenillaCanvas_Sorted()[this:GetID()] if not entry then return end UIDropDownMenu_SetSelectedID(WorldMapZoneDropDown, this:GetID()) chosen = entry.name BenillaCanvas_ZoomTo(BenillaCanvas_ZoomOf(entry), entry.left + entry.width / 2, entry.top + entry.height / 2) WorldMap_UpdateZoneDropDownText() end
local BenillaCanvas_OldZoneText = WorldMap_UpdateZoneDropDownText function WorldMap_UpdateZoneDropDownText() if not onCanvas then BenillaCanvas_OldZoneText() elseif chosen then UIDropDownMenu_SetText(chosen, WorldMapZoneDropDown) else UIDropDownMenu_ClearAll(WorldMapZoneDropDown) end end
local BenillaCanvas_OldZoomOut = WorldMapZoomOutButton_OnClick function WorldMapZoomOutButton_OnClick() if not onCanvas then BenillaCanvas_OldZoomOut() end end
